villagediplomacy.dialog.ally_visit.0: Ah, our trusted ally arrives! Welcome back.
villagediplomacy.dialog.ally_visit.1: You've proven yourself a true friend of this village.
villagediplomacy.dialog.ally_visit.10: If the council ever crowns anyone, it will be you.
villagediplomacy.dialog.ally_visit.2: We talk about you at the council meetings, you know.
villagediplomacy.dialog.ally_visit.3: Your name is spoken with respect here.
villagediplomacy.dialog.ally_visit.4: The elders say you are like family now.
villagediplomacy.dialog.ally_visit.5: Our doors are never locked to you, friend.
villagediplomacy.dialog.ally_visit.6: The gate stays open when we see your banner.
villagediplomacy.dialog.ally_visit.7: Our children wave when they spot your cloak.
villagediplomacy.dialog.ally_visit.8: You have earned more than trust here.
villagediplomacy.dialog.ally_visit.9: Sit. Eat. Nothing in this village is off-limits to you.
villagediplomacy.dialog.become_ally: You are now considered an ally of our village!
villagediplomacy.dialog.become_enemy: You are now considered an enemy of our village!
villagediplomacy.dialog.children.0: Are you a hero? You look like a hero!
villagediplomacy.dialog.children.1: Mom says not to talk to strangers... but you seem nice.
villagediplomacy.dialog.children.10: I drew you! It's a stick figure, but it's you.
villagediplomacy.dialog.children.11: Dad says not to bother you. Am I bothering you?
villagediplomacy.dialog.children.2: I found a cool rock today! Wanna see?
villagediplomacy.dialog.children.3: When I grow up I want to be an adventurer too!
villagediplomacy.dialog.children.4: Do you have any cake? I like cake.
villagediplomacy.dialog.children.5: The golem let me pet it this morning!
villagediplomacy.dialog.children.6: I can run really fast. Watch!
villagediplomacy.dialog.children.7: My brother says you kill zombies in one hit. Is that true?
villagediplomacy.dialog.children.8: I'm not scared of the dark anymore. Almost.
villagediplomacy.dialog.children.9: Do you sleep in a bed? Or in a cave?
villagediplomacy.dialog.friendly.0: Our village is glad to have your support!
villagediplomacy.dialog.friendly.1: We trust you, friend. Come back anytime.
villagediplomacy.dialog.friendly.10: If you head north, take a torch. Trust me.
villagediplomacy.dialog.friendly.11: Anything you need, just knock. We owe you one.
villagediplomacy.dialog.friendly.2: Thanks to you, our village thrives.
villagediplomacy.dialog.friendly.3: You are always welcome at our hearths.
villagediplomacy.dialog.friendly.4: The children speak of your deeds with admiration.
villagediplomacy.dialog.friendly.5: Trade fair, friend, and our doors stay open for you.
villagediplomacy.dialog.friendly.6: The golems nod when you pass. That means something.
villagediplomacy.dialog.friendly.7: Take a seat by the fire, friend. Rest those legs.
villagediplomacy.dialog.friendly.8: The blacksmith asked about you again, you know.
villagediplomacy.dialog.friendly.9: Here, have a carrot. You look half-starved.
villagediplomacy.dialog.greeting.0: Hello, traveler. Welcome to our village.
villagediplomacy.dialog.greeting.1: Good to see you around here.
villagediplomacy.dialog.greeting.10: Well met. Try not to wake the babies.
villagediplomacy.dialog.greeting.11: Stranger or not, nobody walks these roads at night.
villagediplomacy.dialog.greeting.2: What brings you to our lands?
villagediplomacy.dialog.greeting.4: The elders still speak of travelers who helped us long ago.
villagediplomacy.dialog.greeting.5: Mind the path—wolves get bold at dusk.
villagediplomacy.dialog.greeting.6: If you're hungry, the baker might spare a loaf.
villagediplomacy.dialog.greeting.7: Another traveler. You're the third this week.
villagediplomacy.dialog.greeting.8: Come in, come in. Don't just stand at the gate.
villagediplomacy.dialog.greeting.9: You picked a good day, the ovens are still warm.
villagediplomacy.dialog.hostile.10: Say one word to that child and I'll shout for the golem.
villagediplomacy.dialog.hostile.3: We remember what you did. Be gone!
villagediplomacy.dialog.hostile.4: Iron remembers every blow you've dealt here.
villagediplomacy.dialog.hostile.5: One more misstep and the meeting bell rings for you alone.
villagediplomacy.dialog.hostile.6: Don't touch the livestock. Don't test us.
villagediplomacy.dialog.hostile.7: Thieves sleep in the mud here. We make sure of it.
villagediplomacy.dialog.hostile.8: There's laundry drying behind you. Not yours.
villagediplomacy.dialog.hostile.9: You ran out of welcome three villages ago.
villagediplomacy.dialog.legendary.0: A living legend walks among us! I can't believe it.
villagediplomacy.dialog.legendary.1: My grandfather told stories of heroes like you.
villagediplomacy.dialog.legendary.10: We keep a seat empty at the council table in your name.
villagediplomacy.dialog.legendary.2: Songs will be written about your deeds. I'm sure of it.
villagediplomacy.dialog.legendary.3: The children pretend to be you when they play.
villagediplomacy.dialog.legendary.4: Even the golems seem to stand taller when you're near.
villagediplomacy.dialog.legendary.5: We would follow you into the Nether itself.
villagediplomacy.dialog.legendary.6: They'll name the square after you. I'll propose it myself.
villagediplomacy.dialog.legendary.7: I've told my daughter your stories twice already.
villagediplomacy.dialog.legendary.8: If you ever want to grow old somewhere, let it be here.
villagediplomacy.dialog.legendary.9: The bell rings cleaner when you're in the village. I mean it.
villagediplomacy.dialog.lore.0: This village was founded three generations ago, they say.
villagediplomacy.dialog.lore.1: There's a legend of a great hero who saved us long before you arrived.
villagediplomacy.dialog.lore.10: They say a witch cursed the north field. Nothing has grown there since.
villagediplomacy.dialog.lore.2: The well in the center has never run dry. Not once.
villagediplomacy.dialog.lore.3: Our first iron golem was built during a zombie siege, or so my grandmother said.
villagediplomacy.dialog.lore.4: We used to trade with a village to the east. Haven't heard from them in years.
villagediplomacy.dialog.lore.5: They say if you ring the bell at midnight, the old spirits wake.
villagediplomacy.dialog.lore.6: A traveler once traded a diamond for a shovel. Ask the smith.
villagediplomacy.dialog.lore.7: Our walls are older than the forest around them.
villagediplomacy.dialog.lore.8: Every stone in that tower was carried by hand. Mine too.
villagediplomacy.dialog.lore.9: The first innkeeper kept a ledger of every guest. It's still in the loft.
villagediplomacy.dialog.morning.0: Rise and shine! Another day in the village.
villagediplomacy.dialog.morning.1: Good morning, traveler. The rooster woke us all.
villagediplomacy.dialog.morning.10: Get moving. The sun won't wait and neither will the crops.
villagediplomacy.dialog.morning.2: Early start today—fields don't tend themselves.
villagediplomacy.dialog.morning.3: The baker's bread already smells wonderful this morning.
villagediplomacy.dialog.morning.4: Frost on the ground today. Careful out there.
villagediplomacy.dialog.morning.5: I slept poorly. Something howled near the fence.
villagediplomacy.dialog.morning.6: Sleep well? You've got mud on your boot, by the way.
villagediplomacy.dialog.morning.7: The rooster is louder than the bell. I've complained already.
villagediplomacy.dialog.morning.8: First one up lights the furnace. That's the rule.
villagediplomacy.dialog.morning.9: Breakfast is bread and whatever the chickens gave us.
villagediplomacy.dialog.neutral.0: We neither trust nor distrust you... yet.
villagediplomacy.dialog.neutral.10: The council will decide what to make of you.
villagediplomacy.dialog.neutral.2: Our village remains cautious around outsiders.
villagediplomacy.dialog.neutral.3: Trade fairly and we shall get along.
villagediplomacy.dialog.neutral.4: We've seen heroes and villains wear the same cloak.
villagediplomacy.dialog.neutral.5: Keep your sword sheathed unless the raid horn sounds.
villagediplomacy.dialog.neutral.6: We'll be watching how you treat this place.
villagediplomacy.dialog.neutral.7: No trouble from you, and we'll have no quarrel.
villagediplomacy.dialog.neutral.8: Every kindness is remembered. So is every theft.
villagediplomacy.dialog.neutral.9: You may stay. You do not belong here yet.
villagediplomacy.dialog.night.0: Go inside, traveler. Nothing good roams at night.
villagediplomacy.dialog.night.1: I can't sleep... strange sounds outside.
villagediplomacy.dialog.night.10: There's a spare bedroll in the loft, if you're quiet.
villagediplomacy.dialog.night.2: Keep a torch lit. Darkness brings danger.
villagediplomacy.dialog.night.3: The iron golem seems restless tonight.
villagediplomacy.dialog.night.4: My children asked me why the sky turns dark. I had no good answer.
villagediplomacy.dialog.night.5: Stars are clear tonight. A good omen, I hope.
villagediplomacy.dialog.night.6: Bolt on the door, torch in the window. That's how we sleep.
villagediplomacy.dialog.night.7: If you hear the bell tonight, run to the square.
villagediplomacy.dialog.night.8: My dog won't stop growling at the treeline.
villagediplomacy.dialog.night.9: Keep your sword close. I'm not being dramatic.
villagediplomacy.dialog.quest.0: Could you help us recover something stolen?
villagediplomacy.dialog.quest.1: We need a brave soul for a dangerous task.
villagediplomacy.dialog.quest.2: If you prove your worth, we will reward you well.
villagediplomacy.dialog.quest.3: Bring back three strings from spiders—we'll weave new nets.
villagediplomacy.dialog.quest.4: The river ran cloudy this morning. Could you look upstream?
villagediplomacy.dialog.quest.5: The well needs a new rope. Bring me string and I'll remember it.
villagediplomacy.dialog.quest.6: Two of our sheep wandered north. Bring them back?
villagediplomacy.dialog.quest.7: I'll pay for three logs. My roof leaks and I'm too old to climb.
villagediplomacy.dialog.quest.8: Find my brother's axe near the ravine. He won't go back there.
villagediplomacy.dialog.quest.9: We need iron. Lots of it. We have bread, if that helps.
villagediplomacy.dialog.raid.0: We survived the raid! Thanks to those who fought.
villagediplomacy.dialog.raid.1: Pillagers again... when will they leave us in peace?
villagediplomacy.dialog.raid.10: We lost two doors and a cow. We kept the village.
villagediplomacy.dialog.raid.2: The wall held this time. Next time I'm not so sure.
villagediplomacy.dialog.raid.3: I hid in the cellar with my children. Terrible hours.
villagediplomacy.dialog.raid.4: Every raid leaves scars. On the village and on us.
villagediplomacy.dialog.raid.5: Our golem fought bravely. I saw it take on three of them.
villagediplomacy.dialog.raid.6: They came at dawn. We were still eating.
villagediplomacy.dialog.raid.7: Count the arrows in the wall. That's one raid.
villagediplomacy.dialog.raid.8: My brother-in-law fights for the pillagers now. I don't talk about it.
villagediplomacy.dialog.raid.9: If the horn sounds, children go to the cellar. No arguing.
villagediplomacy.dialog.rain.1: I forgot to bring the hay inside... again.
villagediplomacy.dialog.rain.10: Stand under the awning, you're dripping on my floor.
villagediplomacy.dialog.rain.2: The children love puddles. I don't.
villagediplomacy.dialog.rain.3: Rain means the river runs well.
villagediplomacy.dialog.rain.4: My roof leaks on the east side. Terrible timing.
villagediplomacy.dialog.rain.5: At least the dust settles when it rains.
villagediplomacy.dialog.rain.6: If it keeps up, the river takes the south bridge.
villagediplomacy.dialog.rain.7: My boots are soaked through. Twice today.
villagediplomacy.dialog.rain.8: The wheat is happy. My knees are not.
villagediplomacy.dialog.rain.9: Rain means no raiders. Small mercies.
villagediplomacy.dialog.reputation_down: Your reputation with our village has decreased.
villagediplomacy.dialog.reputation_up: Your reputation with our village has improved!
villagediplomacy.dialog.storm.0: Get inside! Lightning strikes near the fields!
villagediplomacy.dialog.storm.1: Last storm knocked a tree onto the mill. We're still fixing it.
villagediplomacy.dialog.storm.2: The animals are frightened—I can't blame them.
villagediplomacy.dialog.storm.3: Thunder shook the bell tower last night. No cracks, thankfully.
villagediplomacy.dialog.storm.4: If the lightning hits the crops we'll go hungry.
villagediplomacy.dialog.storm.5: Stay clear of the tall tree by the gate. Please.
villagediplomacy.dialog.storm.6: The golem stands in the rain anyway. Stubborn thing.
villagediplomacy.dialog.storm.7: Lightning hit the old barn. Nothing left but nails.
villagediplomacy.dialog.storm.8: I've secured the shutters. Let's hope they hold.
villagediplomacy.dialog.storm.9: Candles, blankets, and no wandering. That's the plan.
villagediplomacy.dialog.trade.0: Looking to trade? I have fine goods.
villagediplomacy.dialog.trade.1: A fair deal benefits us both.
villagediplomacy.dialog.trade.10: Buy the bread. It's the one thing nobody argues about.
villagediplomacy.dialog.trade.2: I might have something useful for you.
villagediplomacy.dialog.trade.3: These prices are the best in the region!
villagediplomacy.dialog.trade.4: Come, let us see what we can arrange.
villagediplomacy.dialog.trade.5: Emeralds don't lie—neither do my prices.
villagediplomacy.dialog.trade.6: Haggling is a fine art. You're not very good at it.
villagediplomacy.dialog.trade.8: Prices are honest here. Ask anyone. Ask the dead.
villagediplomacy.dialog.trade.9: For you? Same price as everyone. That's respect.
villagediplomacy.dialog.warning.0: Be careful, dark creatures roam nearby.
villagediplomacy.dialog.warning.1: We heard strange noises last night...
villagediplomacy.dialog.warning.10: The golems stood watch all night. They never do that.
villagediplomacy.dialog.warning.3: Our village has been under attack recently.
villagediplomacy.dialog.warning.4: Light a torch before the cellar—something skitters down there.
villagediplomacy.dialog.warning.5: The cartographer marks a ruin to the north. Tread carefully.
villagediplomacy.dialog.warning.6: Something's been taking chickens. Two this week.
villagediplomacy.dialog.warning.7: Don't go past the east fence after dark.
villagediplomacy.dialog.warning.8: There's a hole in the hillside. Something lives in it.
villagediplomacy.dialog.warning.9: Keep your armor on, traveler. I'll tell you why later.

villagediplomacy.guard.attack.hero.1: §8[§6%s§8] §e*steps back* I thought we were friends!
villagediplomacy.guard.attack.neutral.1: §8[§6%s§8] §cI knew it! You are no different!

villagediplomacy.guard.entry.enemy.4: §8[§6%s§8] §4You are not getting past me this time!

villagediplomacy.guard.entry.friendly.4: §8[§6%s§8] §7The village sleeps easier with you around.
villagediplomacy.guard.entry.friendly.5: §8[§6%s§8] §7My shift ends at dusk. Bring news if you have any.

villagediplomacy.guard.entry.hero.3: §8[§6%s§8] §e*pounds chest* For the village, and for you!
villagediplomacy.guard.entry.hero.4: §8[§6%s§8] §eThe recruits ask about you. I exaggerate, naturally.
villagediplomacy.guard.entry.hero.5: §8[§6%s§8] §eNorth gate is quiet. Thanks to what you did out there.
villagediplomacy.guard.entry.hero.6: §8[§6%s§8] §e*salutes sharply* An honor to serve beside you.
villagediplomacy.guard.entry.hero.7: §8[§6%s§8] §eIf you ever want a command, just say the word.

villagediplomacy.guard.entry.hostile.4: §8[§6%s§8] §cYou've got until I finish this sentence to be gone.
villagediplomacy.guard.entry.hostile.5: §8[§6%s§8] §c*grips weapon* Don't make me do this.
villagediplomacy.guard.entry.hostile.6: §8[§6%s§8] §cThe children are inside because of YOU.
villagediplomacy.guard.entry.neutral.3: §8[§6%s§8] §7Nothing here worth trouble. Keep it that way.
villagediplomacy.guard.entry.neutral.5: §8[§6%s§8] §7Hands where I can see them, traveler.
villagediplomacy.guard.entry.neutral.6: §8[§6%s§8] §7We count the sheep every night. Just so you know.
